create_ribesscorer: create a RIBES scorer using the register_scorer decorator to score translation hypotheses against references
score_ribes_hypothesis: score a list of hypothesis sentences against multiple reference sentences using RIBES metric
run_ribes_multiprocess: run RIBES scoring with multiprocess averaging across hypothesis and reference pairs
review_ribesscorer_score: review the RIBESScorer.score method that computes per-sentence RIBES scores
summarize_get_sent_ribes: summarize the _get_sent_ribes function that joins references and computes per-sentence RIBES scores
